title: 2019-20 Panini NBA Hoops Silver #86 Wilson Chandler Brooklyn Nets Card
categoryName: Sports Mem, Cards & Fan Shop:Sports Trading Cards:Trading Card Singles
descriptionText:
This 2019-20 Panini NBA Hoops Silver trading card features Wilson Chandler, a player for both the Los Angeles Clippers and Brooklyn Nets. The card is part of the base set and is parallel/variety silver. It is also serial numbered and has a print run of 199. 

The card is perfect for collectors of National Basketball Association (NBA) memorabilia and sports trading cards. It is an excellent addition to any collection and would make a great gift for a basketball fan. Get your hands on this rare card now!
